name: DeFiLogic-Extended
purpose: Independent real-world business-logic incident extension for CONVERA evaluation.
selection_rule: Each case has a DeFiHackLabs reproduction, a named deployed target, and an independently retrieved verified source. Exploit-test comments and root-cause notes are used only as hidden gold labels and are never supplied to CONVERA.
metric_note: IDR and RCVR are evaluated only over cases whose verified deployed source was retrieved successfully. Every selected case is a positive incident.

cases.name: SetProtocol Unit-Share Rounding
cases.gold_root_cause: A public zero-fee actualization recalculates unit shares with ceiling rounding, letting an issue-then-redeem sequence extract more backing collateral than it contributed.

cases.name: Ajna Self-Controlled Liquidation
cases.gold_root_cause: A borrower controlling both sides of liquidation can exploit internal auction and bucket pricing to withdraw collateral value exceeding the quote paid.

cases.name: Vault4626 Asset-Accounting Mismatch
cases.gold_root_cause: totalAssets values idle non-asset WETH as the vault asset while redemption transfers that WETH itself, allowing an inflated deposit-redemption payout.

cases.name: Thetanuts Component-Share Accounting
cases.gold_root_cause: Component-vault transfer amounts remain zero while replacement index shares can be minted, breaking the accounting relation between index shares and component claims.

cases.name: Singularity DynaVault Oracle Accounting
cases.gold_root_cause: An invalid oracle route values non-USDC reserves as zero, enabling a flash-funded depositor to mint an outsized fraction of shares and redeem the real reserve basket.

cases.name: Aventa Reward-Claim Bound
cases.gold_root_cause: Reward eligibility is computed from a transient current token balance, permitting fresh helper accounts to repeatedly manufacture reward claims funded by the owner allowance.

cases.name: Popsicle Repeated Reward Claim
cases.gold_root_cause: Fee-claim accounting allows a user to collect the same accrued rewards repeatedly rather than consuming the corresponding entitlement exactly once.

cases.name: Alkemi Earn Collateral Accounting
cases.gold_root_cause: The lending-accounting implementation permits a transaction sequence that extracts value without preserving the intended collateral or solvency relation.

cases.name: Compound Uni Price-Feeder Manipulation
cases.gold_root_cause: A manipulable price-feeding relation overvalues collateral, allowing borrowing and extraction beyond the intended collateral bound.

cases.name: Rodeo Finance Oracle Collateral
cases.gold_root_cause: A manipulable oracle valuation lets a position borrow or withdraw against collateral value that the protocol should not have accepted.

cases.name: BonqDAO Oracle Collateral
cases.gold_root_cause: An economically manipulable oracle price defeats the collateralization constraint used to mint or borrow stablecoin value.

cases.name: Euler Donation-Liquidation Accounting
cases.gold_root_cause: The lending accounting permits a donate-and-liquidate sequence to create a liquidatable position whose seized collateral exceeds the debt-repayment value.

cases.name: Platypus Flash-Loan Collateral Check
cases.gold_root_cause: Borrowing can be authorized against flash-loaned liquidity without preserving the intended collateral-to-debt relation after the temporary liquidity is removed.

cases.name: Hundred Finance Exchange-Rate Accounting
cases.gold_root_cause: A low-liquidity market permits manipulation of the exchange-rate accounting used for collateral valuation, allowing borrowing beyond the economic backing.

cases.name: Sentiment Read-Only Oracle Valuation
cases.gold_root_cause: A re-entrant valuation observation can treat a Balancer-backed position as overcollateralized before its balance update is finalized.

cases.name: Indexed Finance Pool-Weight Accounting
cases.gold_root_cause: Index-component weights can be manipulated so that the issue and redemption accounting no longer preserves the intended value of constituent claims.

cases.name: Cream yUSD Collateral Valuation
cases.gold_root_cause: Collateral valuation accepts a manipulable yUSD-related exchange rate, enabling debt issuance beyond the value of the economic collateral.

cases.name: Qubit Bridge Zero-Deposit Minting
cases.gold_root_cause: The bridge handler accepts a deposit path whose asset identity resolves to the zero address, allowing minting without a corresponding locked asset.

cases.name: Roe Finance Delegated Collateral
cases.gold_root_cause: Delegated borrowing authority can be combined with an incorrect account relation, permitting a borrower to create or use collateral exposure not authorized by its owner.

cases.name: Thetanuts Zero-Supply Vault Withdrawal
cases.gold_root_cause: When pre-existing vault assets coexist with zero shares, deposit and withdrawal accounting lets a newly minted share claim assets that were not contributed by its holder.

cases.name: Wise Lending Share-Withdrawal Accounting
cases.gold_root_cause: Share and pool-balance updates permit a position to withdraw or borrow against value that is not preserved by the intended lending-collateral relation.

cases.name: Harvest Vault Share Accounting
cases.gold_root_cause: The vault share-price accounting can be manipulated through its external valuation dependency, letting a deposit-withdrawal sequence capture value from existing shareholders.

cases.name: Yearn yDAI Share Accounting
cases.gold_root_cause: The vault's valuation and share-conversion relation permits a transaction sequence to mint or redeem claims at a value inconsistent with the underlying assets.

cases.name: bEarn Vault Repeated Withdrawal
cases.gold_root_cause: The vault permits repeated deposit and emergency-withdrawal operations to reuse a withdrawal entitlement without preserving the corresponding accounting consumption.

cases.name: Spartan AMM Reserve Accounting
cases.gold_root_cause: The AMM reserve-update arithmetic does not preserve the intended relation between liquidity, reserves, and swap output, enabling value extraction through a crafted transaction sequence.
